title: Relay sender maps a home's typed writer-admission 503 ("nothing committed, retry") to UNKNOWN instead of keeping it definite
outcome: Relay sender maps a home's typed writer-admission 503 ("nothing committed, retry") to UNKNOWN instead of keeping it definite
acceptance: A native relay send whose home refuses at writer admission (the typed 503 'mailbox storage is temporarily busy …; no mailbox write was committed by this operation, so retry the same request') reaches the sender as that definite nothing-committed refusal, not as federation_mailbox_unknown_outcome; other authenticated non-4xx replies keep their current UNKNOWN mapping.
A behaviour test drives a relay send against a home that refuses at writer admission and shows the definite refusal at the sender, with no message saved.
